notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Smoky Barbecue Beef and Pumpkin Bowl
description: A colourful bowl of smoky beef, roasted pumpkin, beans, rice and avocado.
steps: Roast diced pumpkin at 220°C with oil and salt until tender and browned, about 25 minutes.
Cook rice; rinse and warm the beans in a small pan.
Sear beef in a hot pan until cooked to your liking, then toss with barbecue sauce.
Build bowls with rice, beans, pumpkin, sliced beef and avocado.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Spicy Blackened Basa Po' Boy
description: A crisp fish sandwich with sweet-potato wedges and tangy cucumber pickle.
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut sweet potato into wedges, oil and roast until crisp and tender.
Season fish with paprika, salt and pepper; pan-fry until opaque and flaky.
Thinly slice cucumber and toss with vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Spread mayonnaise in rolls, add fish and cucumber, and serve with wedges.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Chicken Cobb Salad with Avocado and Yoghurt Ranch
description: A hearty chopped salad with warm chicken, egg, avocado and a herby yoghurt dressing.
steps: Hard-boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool and quarter.
Season chicken and pan-fry until cooked through; rest and slice.
Mix yoghurt, dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper for the dressing.
Arrange leaves, sliced avocado, eggs and chicken; drizzle with dressing.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Falafel, Loaded Hummus and Pita Chips
description: Crisp pita chips and falafel served over hummus with a fresh chopped salad.
steps: Cut pita into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 200°C until crisp, about 10 minutes.
Cook falafel according to packet directions until hot and golden.
Dice cucumber and tomato, then toss with lemon juice and salt.
Spread hummus on plates, top with falafel and salad, and serve with pita chips.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Mushroom 'Meat' Tacos with Carrot Slaw
description: Savoury mushroom tacos with crunchy carrot and cabbage slaw and smoky sauce.
steps: Finely chop mushrooms and cook in a hot pan until their moisture evaporates and edges brown.
Season with paprika, salt and pepper; cook for another minute.
Grate carrot, shred cabbage and toss with a little vinegar and mayonnaise.
Warm tortillas and fill with mushrooms and slaw.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Crunchy Miso Chicken and Ginger Rice
description: Golden miso chicken served with ginger rice and a bright avocado-edamame salsa.
steps: Cook rice with grated ginger according to packet directions; cook edamame until tender.
Coat chicken with miso thinned with a spoonful of water, then press into panko.
Pan-fry in a shallow layer of oil until golden and cooked through, turning carefully.
Serve sliced chicken with ginger rice, edamame and diced avocado dressed with lime.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Easy Asian Barbecue Chicken with Udon Noodles
description: Sticky barbecue chicken with quick-cooked udon and colourful vegetables.
steps: Prepare udon according to packet directions.
Slice chicken and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add capsicum and broccoli with a splash of water; cover briefly to steam until crisp-tender.
Stir in barbecue sauce, soy and noodles; toss to coat and heat through.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Fast Smoky Chorizo Gnocchi with Spinach
description: Pan-crisped gnocchi with smoky chorizo, tomatoes and wilted spinach.
steps: Slice chorizo and fry until browned; remove and set aside, leaving the oil in the pan.
Add gnocchi and cook until golden, turning often.
Add garlic and tomatoes; cook until tomatoes soften and gnocchi are tender.
Return chorizo, fold through spinach until wilted, and finish with parmesan.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Kofta-Spiced Salmon with Rice and Roast Vegetables
description: Warmly spiced salmon with rice and a tray of caramelised vegetables.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Chop zucchini and capsicum, toss with oil and roast until tender.
Cook rice according to packet directions.
Rub salmon with cumin, salt and oil; bake or pan-sear until opaque and just flaking.
Serve salmon with rice, roast vegetables and lemon wedges.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Beef Rump Steaks and Salsa Verde
description: Seared rump steaks with crisp hasselback potatoes and punchy herb sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Make thin cuts across each potato without cutting through; oil, season and roast until crisp and tender.
Finely chop parsley and capers; mix with olive oil, lemon juice and black pepper.
Season steaks and sear in a hot pan to your preferred doneness; rest for 5 minutes.
Slice steak across the grain and serve with potatoes and salsa verde.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Crunchy Fish Katsu Rice Bowls
description: Crisp crumbed fish over rice with avocado, radish and seaweed.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Cut fish into portions, coat in flour, beaten egg and panko, then shallow-fry until crisp and cooked through.
Slice avocado and radish; cut or crumble nori.
Serve fish over rice with vegetables and a little soy sauce.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: BBQ Balinese Satay Chicken with Rice
description: Grilled satay-style chicken with rice and charred cabbage salad.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Whisk peanut butter with soy, lime juice and warm water to make a pourable sauce.
Thread chicken pieces onto skewers and grill or pan-sear until browned and cooked through.
Char cabbage wedges in a hot pan and serve with rice, chicken and satay sauce.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Chargrilled Pork Steaks with Country Potatoes
description: Juicy pork with crispy potatoes and a tangy, smoky cabbage slaw.
steps: Cut potatoes into chunks, season and roast at 220°C until golden and tender.
Shred cabbage and toss with vinegar, yoghurt, paprika and salt.
Season pork and grill or sear until cooked through; rest for 3 minutes.
Serve pork with potatoes and smoky slaw.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Garlic Ginger Prawns with Spicy Asian Slaw
description: Quick garlic prawns with crunchy cabbage, chilli and toasted coconut.
steps: Toast coconut in a dry pan until golden; set aside.
Shred cabbage and carrot and dress with lime juice, a little oil and sliced chilli.
Fry garlic and ginger briefly, add prawns and cook until pink and opaque.
Serve prawns with slaw and toasted coconut.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Barramundi with Sweet Soy Greens
description: Pan-seared barramundi with green vegetables and oven-baked potato wedges.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges and roast at 220°C until golden.
Mix soy sauce, honey, crushed garlic and a spoonful of water.
Steam broccoli until just tender; pan-sear barramundi until opaque and flaky.
Spoon sweet soy sauce over fish and greens; serve with wedges.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Smoky Haloumi Tacos with Creamy Cabbage Slaw
description: Seared haloumi tucked into warm tortillas with a cool, tangy slaw.
steps: Shred cabbage and toss with yoghurt, lime juice and salt.
Slice haloumi and dust lightly with smoked paprika.
Sear haloumi in a hot dry pan until golden on both sides.
Warm tortillas and fill with haloumi and creamy slaw.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Malaysian Tofu with Cucumber Salsa and Broccoli
description: Crisp tofu with a coconut-spiced sauce, fresh cucumber salsa and broccoli.
steps: Pat tofu dry, cube and pan-fry until golden; set aside.
Simmer curry paste in a little oil, add coconut milk and broccoli, and cook until broccoli is tender.
Return tofu and simmer gently until warmed through.
Dice cucumber and dress with lime; serve salsa alongside the tofu curry.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Tex-Mex Chicken Burger with Sweet Potato Fries
description: A spiced chicken burger with crisp sweet-potato fries and fresh salad.
steps: Cut sweet potato into fries, season and roast at 220°C until tender and browned.
Season chicken with paprika, salt and oil; cook in a pan until fully cooked.
Toast buns and spread with mayonnaise.
Build burgers with chicken and lettuce; serve with sweet-potato fries.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Sweet Ginger Beef Stir-Fry with Sesame Rice
description: Ginger-glazed beef and crisp pak choy over nutty sesame rice.
steps: Cook rice, then stir in a teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
Mix soy, honey, grated ginger and a splash of water.
Sear beef in a hot pan, add sliced pak choy and stir-fry until just wilted.
Pour in sauce and toss until glossy; serve with sesame rice.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Tex-Mex Haloumi Burger with Sweet Potato Fries
description: Golden haloumi burgers with paprika fries and crunchy lettuce.
steps: Cut sweet potato into fries, season with paprika and roast at 220°C until tender.
Slice haloumi and sear in a hot pan until browned on both sides.
Toast buns and slice avocado and lettuce.
Fill buns with haloumi, avocado and lettuce; serve with fries.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pot Pie
description: A comforting chicken and vegetable filling under a cheesy mashed-potato crust.
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil potatoes until tender, mash with milk and half the cheese.
Dice chicken and carrot; cook in a pan until chicken is browned, then add peas and a simple flour-thickened stock sauce.
Transfer filling to an ovenproof dish and spread mash over the top; scatter over remaining cheese.
Bake until bubbling and golden, about 20 minutes; ensure chicken is cooked through.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Smoky Beef Burgers and Wedges
description: Homemade smoky beef patties with potato wedges and a fresh garden salad.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges, oil and roast at 220°C until crisp and cooked through.
Season beef with paprika, salt and pepper; shape into patties and pan-fry until fully cooked.
Toast buns and slice tomatoes.
Assemble burgers with salad leaves and tomato; serve with wedges.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Chicken and Potato Salad with Tomato, Dill and Egg
description: A satisfying warm salad with tender chicken, potatoes and a tangy dill dressing.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; hard-boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool and quarter.
Season chicken and pan-fry until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Whisk olive oil with vinegar, dill, salt and pepper.
Toss warm potatoes with dressing and tomato; top with chicken and egg.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Smoky Haloumi Burgers and Wedges
description: Golden haloumi burgers with crisp potato wedges and a simple garden salad.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with paprika and oil, and roast at 220°C until crisp.
Slice haloumi and sear in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Toast buns and slice tomato.
Assemble burgers with haloumi and salad leaves; serve with wedges.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Fast Steakhouse Beef Nachos with Guacamole
description: Weeknight beef nachos with quick guacamole, tomato and melted cheese.
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Brown beef mince in a pan and season with cumin, salt and pepper.
Stir in drained beans, then layer beef and chips in an ovenproof dish; scatter over cheese.
Bake until cheese melts, about 8 minutes.
Mash avocado with lime and salt, dice tomato, and serve with the hot nachos.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Spicy Tex-Mex Beef Tacos with Creamy Slaw
description: Chilli-spiced beef tacos with cool slaw and a smoky mustard dressing.
steps: Brown beef mince with chipotle, cumin and a splash of water until cooked through.
Shred cabbage and toss with yoghurt, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with beef and creamy slaw; adjust chilli to taste.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Parmesan Chicken and Roast Potato
description: Crisp parmesan-coated chicken with roasted potatoes and a ribboned vegetable salad.
steps: Roast diced potatoes at 220°C with oil and salt until golden and tender.
Coat chicken in beaten egg and grated parmesan; bake or pan-fry until cooked through and crisp.
Use a peeler to make ribbons of zucchini and carrot; dress with lemon and olive oil.
Serve chicken with roast potatoes and vegetable ribbons.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Tofu, Noodle and Sweet Soy Stir-Fry
description: Golden tofu noodles with green beans and carrot in a sweet soy glaze.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions and drain.
Pat tofu dry, cube and fry until golden on all sides.
Add sliced beans and carrot with a splash of water; stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Add noodles, soy sauce and sugar; toss until coated and hot.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry with Ginger and Oyster Sauce
description: Chicken and noodles tossed with ginger, crunchy greens and a savoury sauce.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions and drain.
Stir-fry sliced chicken until cooked through; add grated ginger, broccoli and carrot.
Add a splash of water and cover briefly to soften the vegetables.
Toss in noodles and oyster sauce; heat through and serve.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Smoky Chicken Tacos with Creamy Slaw
description: Smoky pan-cooked chicken in soft tortillas with a cool creamy cabbage slaw.
steps: Season chicken with paprika, salt and oil; cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Shred cabbage and toss with mayonnaise, lime juice and salt.
Rest chicken briefly, then slice into strips.
Warm tortillas and fill with chicken and creamy slaw.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Chicken and Green Bean Braise with Cheesy Potatoes
description: A homestyle chicken and bean braise served with golden cheesy potatoes.
steps: Roast diced potatoes at 220°C until tender; sprinkle with cheddar for the final 5 minutes.
Brown chicken and sliced onion in a deep pan.
Add stock, cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Add green beans and simmer until tender; serve with cheesy potatoes.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Beef, Noodle and Sweet Soy Stir-Fry
description: Quick beef noodles with green beans and carrot in a sweet soy sauce.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions.
Sear beef in a hot pan in batches, then set aside.
Stir-fry sliced beans and carrot until crisp-tender.
Return beef, add noodles, soy and honey, and toss until hot and glossy.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Smoked Salmon Sushi Bowl with Avocado and Cucumber
description: A quick sushi-inspired rice bowl with smoked salmon and lime dressing.
steps: Rinse rice and cook according to packet directions; season lightly with rice vinegar.
Mix mayonnaise with lime juice and a little water to make a drizzle.
Slice cucumber, avocado and smoked salmon.
Divide rice among bowls and top with salmon, vegetables and lime mayonnaise.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Fast Family Beef Mince Tacos
description: Easy beef tacos with avocado, tomato and cheddar for a build-your-own dinner.
steps: Brown beef mince in a pan, breaking it up; season with cumin, salt and pepper.
Dice tomatoes and avocado and grate cheddar.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or according to packet directions.
Set out the beef and toppings so everyone can assemble their own tacos.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Beef Oyster Sauce Noodles with Honey and Pak Choy
description: Savoury beef noodles with tender greens and a touch of honey.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions and drain.
Sear beef in a hot pan until browned; add carrot and pak choy.
Stir together oyster sauce, honey and a splash of water, then pour into the pan.
Toss with noodles until hot and coated.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Pizzaiola-Style Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
description: Tomato-braised chicken with roasted seasonal vegetables and herbs.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Roast diced potato, zucchini and capsicum with oil until tender.
Season chicken and brown in an ovenproof pan.
Add tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper; simmer briefly, then cover and cook until chicken is done.
Serve chicken and tomato sauce with roast vegetables.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Crispy Chicken Schnitzel Burger with Slaw
description: Crunchy chicken schnitzel in a bun with cabbage slaw and smoky mayonnaise.
steps: Flatten chicken breasts evenly; coat in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Shallow-fry until crisp, golden and cooked through; drain on paper towel.
Shred cabbage and toss with a spoonful of mayonnaise and vinegar.
Mix remaining mayonnaise with paprika, spread in toasted buns and add chicken and slaw.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Risotto
description: Comforting mushroom risotto finished with spinach and toasted pepitas.
steps: Warm stock in a saucepan. Toast pepitas in a dry pan and set aside.
Cook sliced mushrooms in butter until browned; stir in rice and coat the grains.
Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring often until absorbed and rice is creamy and tender.
Fold in spinach and parmesan; serve topped with pepitas.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Mini Beef Meatloaves with Parmesan Wedges
description: Small glazed beef loaves with roast potatoes and wilted spinach.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Cut potatoes into wedges and roast with oil and salt.
Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, grated parmesan and seasoning; shape into four small loaves.
Bake loaves beside the potatoes until browned and cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Wilt spinach in a pan and serve with meatloaves and wedges.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Banh Mi-Style Pork Jasmine Rice Bowl
description: Gingered pork over jasmine rice with quick-pickled vegetables and fresh herbs.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Julienne carrot and toss with rice vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt; leave to pickle briefly.
Brown pork mince with garlic and ginger until cooked through; season with soy sauce.
Serve pork over rice with snow peas, pickled carrot and coriander.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Ginger-Sesame Pork and Jasmine Rice
description: Glazed pork with rice, quick-pickled vegetables and tender broccoli.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Thinly slice cucumber and toss with vinegar and a pinch of salt; set aside.
Sear pork with grated ginger until cooked through; add soy and a little honey to glaze.
Steam broccoli and serve with rice, pork, pickled cucumber and sesame seeds.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.

title: Sesame Chicken Katsu and Japanese Slaw
description: Crisp sesame-crusted chicken with rice and a bright cabbage slaw.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Mix panko with sesame seeds; coat flattened chicken in flour, egg and crumbs.
Shallow-fry chicken until golden and cooked through, turning once.
Shred cabbage and dress with lime and a little oil; serve with sliced chicken and rice.
notes: Menu-inspired; independently drafted home-cook version.
